questions.question: What does Proverbs 16 say to commit to the LORD?
options: Your enemies, and they will be scattered
Your children alone, and they will surely prosper
Your wealth, and it will be multiplied
Your work, and your plans will be established
questions.answer: Your work, and your plans will be established

questions.question: What famous warning about pride does Proverbs 16 contain?
options: A proud heart is the surest of all foundations for true wisdom
Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall
Pride lifts a man up high above his neighbors and wins him much honor
The proud are richly rewarded, but the humble are very soon forgotten
questions.answer: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall

questions.question: Proverbs 16 says the heart of man plans his way, but the LORD establishes his steps.
_____ goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
